records_rule: v2 layout (R28 B126): per record file, the count of each defect class in `class`; a tx record is DC1 when its TXID is in the HF3 table, else DC3; a block record (fees, state roots, wall-1 link blocks) is DC3; DC2 is never per record; the base version's window rows are the base's records

rules.exact: coverage num == den (both integers) and no pending member of the figure's own class in its scope
rules.fix_is_not_restore: a fix status never changes a historical grade (rule 10)
rules.forbidden_unless: bound_type exact over genesis .. now (no figure qualifies while DC2 is open)
rules.no_cross_class_sum: a figure has exactly one class; a figure derived from others names only figures of its own class
